title: 13 Nights of Elvira
description:
S01 E05 — The Gingerdead Man
Blood and an ancient curse allow an executed killer to return as a murderous gingerbread man.

title: Housebound
description: A would-be thief (Morgana O'Reilly) is remanded to the custody of her estranged mother (Rima Te Wiata), who turns out to be correct in her assertion that evil spirits are afoot in their family domicile.

title: The Last Thanksgiving
description: A family of cannibalistic Pilgrims attacks the staff and patrons at a restaurant that stays open for Thanksgiving rather than close in celebration of the holiday.

title: Little Dead Rotting Hood
description: The residents of a small town realize that something is killing wolves and people in the woods.

title: The Girl Who Got Away
description: A female serial killer who killed four young girls is sent away to prison, but a fifth victim escaped with her life. Twenty years later, the killer escapes and begins hunting for the one who got away.

title: The Slumber Party Massacre
description: Someone with a power drill shows up uninvited to Trish's (Michele Michaels) high-school pajama party.

title: Auntie Lee's Meat Pies
description: A devil-worshiping woman sends out her four beautiful nieces to find young men, who are lured back to her place so they can be killed, ground up, and sold as meat pies.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E03 — Accomplices
As outsiders and insiders start to gather on the island, personal lives grow increasingly complex; the first casualties of the virus are made known.

title: The Island
description:
S01 E04 — Probabilities
Local authorities send a pandemic commissioner to take control of the island; Mayor Østergaard and Officer Mikkel don't like the new initiatives.

title: Tales From The Void
description:
S01 E05 — Plastic Smile
Growing up with addicts for parents, Abigail's only solace is an odd porcelain doll named Betsy, Betsy isn't like other dolls; she moves, speaks, cries and Betsy wants Abigail to bring her to a dark tunnel in middle of the woods.

title: The Trouble With Tessa
description:
S01 E05 — Part Five: Alone
Tessa's investigation leads to an unexpected target; their attempt at recovering stolen property spirals into something more ominous when they realize they're trapped in a place not meant to be found-and certainly not meant to be escaped.
